name: SetItemArchiveDateInput
description: Represents the input for setting the archive date for an item.

inputFields.name: archiveDate
inputFields.description: The archive date. A null value will reset the archive date.

inputFields.name: itemId
inputFields.description: The ID of the target item. If both item ID and item path parameters are specified, the item path parameter is ignored.

inputFields.name: itemPath
inputFields.description: The full path of the target item. If both item ID and item path parameters are specified, the item path parameter is ignored.
